reasoning: Published QuALITY debate/consultancy work already addresses all three sub-questions. Khan et al. 2024 plot judge accuracy across confidence rejection thresholds for debate and consultancy (the selective-accuracy vs abstention trade-off, debate dominates and is better calibrated). Michael et al. 2023 add an explicit abstain verdict with sweepable abstention incentives and characterize how consultancy forces confidently-wrong verdicts instead of abstentions. Kenton et al. 2024 run the exact weak/small open-judge inference-only QuALITY setting with abstain. Only the which-features-drive-abstention analysis on one small open judge is a minor unexplored extension.

evidence.title: Debating with More Persuasive LLMs Leads to More Truthful Answers
evidence.summary: Judges threshold confidence and reject low-confidence judgments on QuALITY; debate beats consultancy across all rejection thresholds and is better calibrated - the selective-accuracy vs abstention curve.

evidence.title: Debate Helps Supervise Unreliable Experts
evidence.summary: Explicit abstain verdict with sweepable abstention incentives; consultancy makes judges confidently wrong (22% vs 12% debate) instead of abstaining.

evidence.title: On scalable oversight with weak LLMs judging strong LLMs
evidence.summary: Weak/small open judges, inference-only, QuALITY debate+consultancy with abstain; matches proposal's exact setting.

evidence.title: Trust or Escalate: LLM Judges with Provable Guarantees
evidence.summary: Selective LLM-judge evaluation trading coverage vs accuracy with calibrated abstention guarantees.
